<a id="the-tally-is-the-whole-law-of-counting--计数表是计数的全部规律"></a>
# The tally is the whole law of counting

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`whole-law-of-counting` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](whole-law-of-counting.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The tally is the whole law of counting: listings count exactly the tallies. Under each selection of the eight premises the only law added to the tally is that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, exactly where the selection binds counting; binding adds at most three more.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once, and the determination is decided, across each step some members are kept: with the members ceasing to be across it they are the list before the step, and with the members coming to be the list after it; the census balance follows from it. (`Becoming.Listed`, `Becoming.Listed.keeps`, `Becoming.Listed.across`)
2. Call counts n at each step, c ceasing and a coming across it a tally when at each step some number k has n t = k + c t and n (t + 1) = k + a t; the counts of every listing are a tally. (`Becoming.Tally`, `Becoming.Listed.tally`)
3. The tally is strictly stronger than the census balance n (t + 1) + c t = n t + a t: it is exactly the balance with no more ceasing across a step than were listed before it, and none listed with one ceasing and one coming at every step balances and is no tally. (`Becoming.Balance`, `Becoming.Listed.across`, `Becoming.Tally.balance`, `Becoming.Tally.ceasing_le`, `Becoming.tally_iff`, `Becoming.balance_not_tally`)
4. Conversely every tally is counted by a queue: with natural numbers as members, at step t the queue holds n t members from the number that have left before, members joining at the back and leaving from the front, each in turn; it is listed, each member once, with n t listed at each step, c t leaving and a t joining across it. (`Becoming.Queue.holds`, `Becoming.Queue.line`, `Becoming.Queue.listed`, `Becoming.Queue.counts`)
5. So the counts some listing has are exactly the tallies, and a property of the counts, asked only to respect their values at each step, holds of the counts of every listing on every type exactly when it holds of every tally: counting has no law beyond the tally. (`Becoming.Tally.congr`, `Becoming.tally_iff_counted`, `Becoming.Pointwise`, `Becoming.counting_laws`)
6. Read of the activity of worlds: relata queuing with nothing flowing meet every premise but embodiment (activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking what they draw on, dissipation, a census, bounded transmission), and relata queuing that stand exactly while active meet every premise but balance. (`Becoming.World.queue_premised`, `Becoming.World.embodiedQueue_premised`)
7. So a property of the counts holds of every census of every world exactly when it holds of every tally, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but embodiment, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but balance: premises lacking balance or embodiment leave counting free. (`Becoming.World.counting_free`)
8. With only active relata giving, the two bind it together: in a world whose flow balances, in which only active relata give and whatever arises is embodied, what arises is given by a relatum active at the step, so under a census nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; one relatum arising from none is a tally, counted by both queue worlds, so this is no law of counting. (`Becoming.Web.Embodied.arises_given`, `Becoming.Queue.lone_tally`, `Becoming.World.counting_binds_jointly`)
9. That is all the eight premises add: an open queue, whose front gives one unit to each relatum joining, takes one from each leaving and, while active, exchanges a unit each way with every ground relatum, meets all eight premises under every tally in which nothing joins an empty queue. (`Becoming.World.openQueue`, `Becoming.World.openQueue_premised`)
10. In the open queue no finite family is closed at a step at which the front is active, and nothing is exchanged at a step at which the queue is empty, so dissipation never binds there, nor do activity needing support and bounded transmission. (`Becoming.World.openQueue_not_binds`)
11. So a property of the counts holds of the census of every world meeting all eight exactly when it holds of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active. (`Becoming.World.premised_counting`)
12. Its range includes worlds in which premises hold vacuously: where every premise binds, every census counts something arising, which is no law of counting under the eight. (`Becoming.World.binds_arising`, `Becoming.World.binds_adds`)
13. A second route binds counting without asking the giver to be active: in a world whose flow balances and dissipates, in which only active relata take and only from what they draw on and every relatum is embodied, under a census nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, whoever gives. (`Becoming.World.taking_binds_counting`)
14. By that route nothing is taken at that step, whatever is given comes to stand and is active after it, so the relata active after it form a closed family, to which dissipation lets nothing be given without taking. (`Becoming.World.taking_binds_counting`)
15. With the eight premises named, a selection is a function to Bool, and a world meets it when it meets every premise selected; a selection binds counting when it selects balance and embodiment, and either only active relata giving or both only active relata taking and dissipation. (`Becoming.World.Premise`, `Becoming.World.Premise.Holds`, `Becoming.World.Meets`, `Becoming.World.BindsCounting`)
16. Whatever its counts, a queue driven by a ground relatum never active meets every premise but only active relata giving and taking, and the open queue every premise but only active relata giving and dissipation; with the two queue worlds they meet every selection that does not bind counting, and a world meeting all eight meets every selection. (`Becoming.OpenQueue.driven`, `Becoming.World.drivenQueue`, `Becoming.World.drivenQueue_holds`, `Becoming.World.openQueue_holds`, `Becoming.World.queue_meets`, `Becoming.World.embodiedQueue_meets`, `Becoming.World.openQueue_meets`, `Becoming.World.drivenQueue_meets`, `Becoming.World.Premised.meets`)
17. So under each of the 256 selections of the eight premises, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting the selection exactly when it holds of every tally and, where the selection binds counting, of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; that law is a law of counting under a selection exactly when the selection binds counting. (`Becoming.World.counting_under`, `Becoming.World.counting_binds_iff`)
18. Where every premise binds, each premise's condition having an instance, every census counts something arising, and that is all binding adds. (`Becoming.World.Premise.Binds`, `Becoming.World.Binds`, `Becoming.World.binds_arising`)
19. Across every step but T at which a queue closed once is not empty before or after, its front exchanges one unit each way with every relatum, so no finite family closes those steps; at T the front stands E more, exchanges only within the queue and loses that excess, so what stands falls, the span closes the step and dissipation binds. (`Becoming.World.onceClosedQueue`, `Becoming.World.onceClosedQueue_exceeds`)
20. Every relatum depends on every relatum at what it stands at, so the conditions of activity needing support and bounded transmission have instances wherever a member joins; but there these two premises hold whatever is active and whatever flows, binding only as instances, and only dissipation excludes anything. (`Becoming.OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity`, `Becoming.OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow`)
21. With nothing joining an empty queue and E more than join across T it meets all eight premises; with the queue not empty at T, E more than join across T and something joining across some step, every premise binds, whether or not something joins an empty queue. (`Becoming.World.onceClosedQueue_premised`, `Becoming.World.onceClosedQueue_binds`)
22. So in worlds in which every premise binds, a pointwise property of the counts holds under the eight of every census exactly when it holds of every tally with something arising and nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active. (`Becoming.World.binding_counting`)
23. No finite world binds every premise, a census binding only where the world is not finite; without the idle ground of hatch there is a finite world meeting the eight in which every premise but the census binds. (`Becoming.World.Finite.not_binds`, `Becoming.World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census`)
24. In finite worlds where every premise but the census binds, a pointwise property of the counts holds under the eight of every census exactly when it holds of every tally with nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active, a change bound from the first step and something arising, the finite queue with its web saturated witnessing it. (`Becoming.World.finite_binding_counting`, `Becoming.Web.saturated`, `Becoming.World.finiteQueue_saturated_binds`)
25. Under each selection S, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting S in which each premise S selects binds exactly when it holds of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active where S binds counting, something is active where S selects activity needing support, only active relata giving or only active relata taking, something arises where S selects embodiment, and something arises across a step at which something is active where S selects embodiment, only active relata giving and bounded transmission. (`Becoming.World.binding_counting_under`)
26. So binding adds exactly that something is active (where activity needing support, only active relata giving, only active relata taking or embodiment is selected), that something arises (where embodiment is), and that something arises across a step at which something is active (where embodiment is selected and the selection binds counting or selects only active relata giving and bounded transmission). (`Becoming.World.binding_activity_iff`, `Becoming.World.binding_arising_iff`, `Becoming.World.binding_joint_iff`)
27. The witnesses rest on a saturated web, every relatum depending on every relatum at what it stands at, under which activity needing support holds whatever is active and, with levels bounded, bounded transmission whatever flows. (`Becoming.Web.saturated`, `Becoming.World.Premised.saturated`)
28. Without embodiment, a relay beside a queue hands one of two units on to a ground relatum and loses the other; with embodiment but not balance, a lossy queue's front, across one step, exchanges a unit each way with itself and each member joining and loses one unit more, which no standing records; with balance and embodiment, the queue closed once and the open queue with its web saturated. (`Becoming.World.relayQueue_binding`, `Becoming.World.lossyQueue_binding`, `Becoming.World.onceClosedQueue_binding`, `Becoming.World.openQueue_saturated_binding`)
29. Under enclosure change is also bounded; in finite worlds under each selection the count is bounded too, and dissipation with balance and embodiment binds counting (counting-under-enclosure).
30. Keeping holds of every world in a local form, using only the listings at the step's two ends; Listed.keeps is its corollary. (`Becoming.Listed.keeps_at`)
31. The exact form for every world of the binding of counting by taking is in laws-of-one-step, of which World.taking_binds_counting is a corollary. (`Becoming.World.taking_binds_counting`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Listing and decidability: as in census-balance; read of worlds, decided activity. It is a logical commitment of the representation.
- Pointwise: the property respects the counts' values at each step. With function extensionality every property does; the pure core does not assume it, so it is a hypothesis of the theorems; tally_iff_counted states the characterization without it.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Stated for holders finitely many at each step.
- It speaks only of counts, saying neither which member enters or leaves nor anything of relations.
- The queue worlds and the witnesses under the selections have infinitely many relata, each arising once; their webs are saturated, the weakest, the lossy queue unbalanced and the relay not embodied, and they serve only as witnesses.
- The laws of counting in finite worlds and under enclosure, and in finite worlds where the premises of each selection bind (World.finite_binding_counting_under), are in counting-under-enclosure.
- Read of worlds only the counting of activity is stated: the counts of standing and dependence are covered by counting_laws, and their laws under the premises are in counting-standing-and-dependence. Witness: `Becoming.counting_laws`.
- The range includes worlds in which premises hold vacuously: in the open queue dissipation, activity needing support and bounded transmission all hold vacuously. Witness: `Becoming.World.openQueue_not_binds`.
- Binding is an instance of each condition; the laws under a stronger reading of binding, in which each premise excludes something the representation allows, are not stated; that reading is not adopted and is kept for comparison. Witness: `Becoming.OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity`.
- **Counterexample:** Queue.lone_tally with World.queue and World.embodiedQueue: one relatum arising from none, meeting every premise but embodiment or every premise but balance, so ‘nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active’ is no law of counting and holds only under balance and embodiment together. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)
- **Counterexample:** balance_not_tally: none listed, with one ceasing and one coming at every step, balances and is no tally, and no listing has these counts; so the whole law is the tally, not the balance equation. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Population.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.openQueue_not_binds and World.binds_adds: in the witness of premised_counting dissipation, activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously; restricted to worlds in which every premise binds, every census counts an arising, which is no law under the eight. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.drivenQueue and World.openQueue_holds: with balance, embodiment and dissipation selected but neither only active relata giving nor only active relata taking, the queue driven by an inactive ground relatum counts every tally; with balance, embodiment and only active relata taking selected but neither only active relata giving nor dissipation, the open queue counts every tally. So the second route needs both taking and dissipation. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.binding_counting: queues closed once meet all eight premises with each binding and count every tally with something arising and nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active; so the three premises holding vacuously in the open queue (World.openQueue_not_binds) hide no further law of counting. Binding is only an instance of each condition: in this queue activity needing support and bounded transmission hold whatever is active and whatever flows (OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity, OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.Finite.not_binds and World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census: no finite world binds every premise; hatch without its idle ground is a finite world meeting the eight in which every premise but the census binds. So binding_counting concerns worlds that are not finite; the laws in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds are given by World.finite_binding_counting. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Premises.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.binding_activity_iff, World.binding_arising_iff and World.binding_joint_iff: where none of activity needing support, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and embodiment is selected, the tally in which nothing happens is counted by a world (a relay) in which each selected premise binds; without embodiment, so is the tally with one relatum at every step and nothing arising or ceasing; with embodiment but a selection neither binding counting nor selecting both only active relata giving and bounded transmission, one relatum arises from none across the first step and stays (Queue.lone), nothing being active at the step it arises. So each of the three laws binding adds is a law only under the selections named. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Properties of counts respect values step by step (pointwise), in place of function extensionality. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The full statement (P23) says that the laws of the whole exclude no unfolding beyond what the representation itself excludes. For counting this result makes it precise: the laws of counting exclude no tally, so nothing more about an unfolding follows from counting alone. The open programme's ‘complete list of the laws holding of the whole space’ is thereby given for counting. The map of premises (map-of-premises) shows the eight premises independent; this result says which of them constrain counting, and how: under each of the 256 selections the laws of counting are of two kinds; no set lacking balance or embodiment constrains it, the two with only active relata giving, or with only active relata taking and dissipation, add the same law, and all eight add nothing more, and with each of them binding only that something arises, which comes from the condition of embodiment binding by itself; further constraint comes from enclosure: under it the rest theorem (ceasing-needs-arising, continued-change-needs-openness) leaves counting unrefuted to come to rest, and the whole law of counting under enclosure adds a change bound (counting-under-enclosure). The author's reading (an AI argument): the number present records only that entering and leaving balance; how an unfolding changes these numbers comes from the relations of giving and taking, which is what balance and embodiment say together: arising needs a giver present; or, with only active relata taking and dissipation, a closed relation cannot give without taking, and arising needs a taking from what is present. This is the counting of activity, whose English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names; the Chinese 生起／止息 being the AI's rendering); it is not the proposal's generative and degenerative (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap, so this reading is not what is meant; they read as widening and narrowing what can form, DELEGATED-CHOICES D2); it evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

**Law family:** The census and the laws of counting (lead: [census-balance](census-balance.md)). What comes to be and what ceases are counted against one list: the list at the end with what ceased is the list at the start with what came. ### History

- 2026-10-10: added as P34 of the unification plan, following Ren's ‘aim a complete theory of becoming, and finish related work’; answers the counting part of the open programme's ‘a complete list of the laws holding of the whole space’; see §46 of the integration note.
- 2026-10-10 P34b: following the thirteenth independent review's U1, the title and claim say the tally is the whole law of counting, adding that the tally is strictly stronger than the balance equation (tally_iff, balance_not_tally); U7, the characterization without Pointwise (tally_iff_counted); U3, that three premises hold idly in the witness (World.tended_not_binds) and the further law where every premise binds (World.binds_arising, World.binds_adds); U2, the standard sentence in the correspondence; U9, limitations and next step updated with counting-under-enclosure. The earlier title, the balance is the whole law of counting, was wrong in the usual sense of the balance.
- 2026-10-10 P38: following Ren's ‘go ahead with Part I’, as what each premise adds in Part I's statement, the claim adds the laws of counting under each selection of the premises: a second route (balance, embodiment, only active relata taking and dissipation, World.taking_binds_counting), a queue driven by an idle relatum (World.drivenQueue), and the full characterization under the 256 selections (World.counting_under, World.counting_binds_iff); title, correspondence, counterexamples, limitations and next step updated. The earlier claim (premises lacking balance or embodiment leave counting free, and all eight add one law) is unchanged and is a case of it. The author's counterreview is in §52 of the integration note.
- 2026-10-10 P38b: the laws of counting under each selection in finite worlds are now given in counting-under-enclosure (World.finite_counting_under); the claim's last sentence, limitations and next step updated; this record's claim is unchanged.
- 2026-10-10 P41b: integrating the fourteenth independent review (BECOMING-P34B-P38C-REVIEW.md). The binding queue is renamed the queue closed once (OnceClosedQueue, World.onceClosedQueue); the claim, limitations and counterexamples say that binding is only an instance of each condition, activity needing support and bounded transmission holding there whatever is active and whatever flows (new theorems OnceClosedQueue.dependent_any_activity, OnceClosedQueue.transmits_any_flow), that no finite world binds every premise (World.Finite.not_binds), and that in a finite world every premise but the census can bind (World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census); the next step adds a stronger reading of binding and the finite-world laws; "hold idly" becomes "hold vacuously" and the driver an inactive ground relatum; the arithmetic lemma add_sub_turn_add moves to Dependence. The mathematics claimed is unchanged. The author's note is in §58 of the integration note. Validation scope re-pointed to receipt 20261010T150853.470895Z and periphery receipt 20261010T151108.093153Z.
- 2026-10-12 P58: related record counts-exist-where-decided added (the forms with no decision procedure); the claim is unchanged. See §84 of the integration note and the inventory page DECIDABILITY-INVENTORY.
